title: Concept: SQL Server error detail disclosed in a response
description: A SQL Server ODBC driver error block in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The block names the driver, the server product and the failing object, which is a precise map of the data layer.
applicability: Deployments that render a SQL Server ODBC driver error block into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The block names the driver, the server product and the failing object, which is a precise map of the data layer.
